panels.notes: Viewed the pixels: line-art life chart with year-only axis ticks, episode labels and treatment labels; no names, IDs, birth dates, device text, faces or anatomy. Year-only ticks are chart data, not burned-in timestamps (prefill timestamp hint rejected).

burned_in: The year ticks printed on the time axis are 2004, 2005, 2012, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2024.
The caption dates the fifth depressive episode to 2024 whereas the case text and Figure 2 date the recurrence to December 2023;

panels.burned_in_description: Full day-level calendar dates of clinical assessments printed in the timeline text (plus year.month phase dates); no names or record numbers.
